scenarios.title: Attacking does not cause a creature with vigilance to tap
decisions: A attacks player B with Alpine Watchdog.

variants.label: vigilance_attacker
variants.expected: Alpine Watchdog is attacking and untapped. Its combat damage puts B at 18.

variants.label: plain_attacker
variants.delta: A attacks with Grizzly Bears instead of Alpine Watchdog.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is attacking and tapped. Its combat damage puts B at 18.
